comments.body_html:
To customize the avatar, there are four steps

1. set the avatar URL in trader base, the game client will request the avatar asset from this URL

avatar:“/files/trader/avatar/aiotrader.png“,

2. tell the AKI server where to find this image when receiving that request

constimageRouter= container.resolve(“ImageRouter”);
imageRouter.addRoute(“/files/trader/avatar/aiotrader“,${modLoader.getModPath(modName)}avatar/aiotrader.png);

3. put the image to the location that you set, in this mod is ‘bluehead-AIOTrader/avatar/aiotrader.png’,

4. clear temp files in AKI launcher -> settings to force client to refresh assets cache.

I don’t know if this is the best practice, but it works for this mod, have fun : )

comments.body_html: It just does that, regardless of your hardware. Game reloads the trader’s inventory to account for changes in item counts, even if the item is unlimited in number, in order to accommodate a live market across an entire server. SPT still does this, even though there is no live market. The more items in a trader’s inventory, the longer it takes. Normally, traders only have so large a selection of items, so it’s not noticeable, but since AIO has literally every item in the entire game in its inventory (vanilla or otherwise)… yeah.
